authorizationContext: Wave 1 after frozen 225-turn baseline and CP4, as instructed by root.

baselineCause.observedByParent: A03-T01 refused as patient-level for a scientific first-person introduction.
baselineCause.verifiedInOwner: The prior PATIENT_LEVEL regular expression classified mon/ma/mes, j’ai, chez moi and pour moi without examining the referent.

changes: Replace bare possessive and first-person markers with local positive attachment to clinical or private referents.
Generic result/value/measurement/data heads require a personal or medical qualifier or an attached clinical referent; ownership of work is insufficient.
First-person avoir requires a clinical experience or individual age; research discourse verbs and mal compris do not count as patient evidence.
Potentially polysemous heads such as treatment, examination and pressure require a qualified clinical phrase or a bounded individual assertion.
Normalize French case, apostrophe, accents and spacing once and reuse exactly the same predicate for sensitivity classification, persistence and the Domain Gate.
Preserve direct-identifier and secret patterns and the existing external transmission restrictions.

counterexamples: Work possessives with clinical terms elsewhere in the sentence.
Experimental measurements, research results, thermal treatments and vapor pressure.
J’ai besoin/prévu/étudié/mal compris and nonpersonal Pour moi.
Symptoms, biomarker values, disease, pain, individual age and private family/contact/financial data.
Mixed scientific and personal clauses without whole-message exemption.
Email, phone, birth date, patient identifier and secret preservation.
Shared Domain Gate and sensitivity predicate, no external call for individual cases.

risksAndLimits: The detector is a deterministic bounded lexical classifier, not a general clinical or privacy comprehension capability.
Unlisted conditions, novel names, distant anaphora, other languages, spelling errors and complex syntactic attachment are not comprehensively covered; no universal privacy recall claim.
Short ambiguous individual-looking expressions may still overblock, including polysemous medical/technical heads without enough context.
Unqualified ownership of results or data no longer suffices for restriction; sensitivity needs an explicit personal/clinical referent or a direct identifier.
No statement here qualifies scientific correctness, adopted project semantics, or the complete 225-turn campaign.
